result.biggest_money_lever: The single highest expected-P&L move is the META-LABEL CALIBRATION LEAK FIX (train_better, pick #6) shipped FIRST as the enabling multiplier on the entire pick/size stack — NOT because its standalone dollars are the largest, but because it is the only VERIFIED-IN-CODE defect (meta_label.py:311-326: IsotonicRegression fits on exactly the X[split:] slice the LightGBM booster early-stopped on, with no purge) that BOTH (a) directly degrades realized P&L today on the binding-cost margin — a leaked, upward-biased p drives a LIVE hard veto (p<0.30, base_loop.py:1124) and a LIVE size multiplier (clip(2p,0.6,1.3), meta_label.py:186), so it currently fills some genuinely-sub-hurdle trades that pay ~6-50bps and bleed, and over-sizes trades whose true win-prob is below the displayed value — AND (b) is a HARD PREREQUISITE for the three sizing/selection levers that are individually larger (conviction flagship #3, edge-Kelly #4, crypto CS rank #7): every one of them sizes or selects the WRONG names if p is miscalibrated (high-vol MSTR/COIN read a higher p than COST at equal true edge, so concentration tilts into the highest-VOL not the highest-EDGE names). It is cheap, soundness-grade, default-off-reversible, adds ZERO turnover, can only TIGHTEN the cost-aware veto, and its purged-cross-fit logic is Mac-buildable today. It is the cornerstone the rest of the wave-9 money plan is built on. RUNNER-UP for largest STANDALONE structural unlock: promoting the diversified candidate pool into the live tradable universe (#1) — but that one is genuinely uncertain (gated on whether the momentum-trained model has positive IC on megacap defensives), so it is a cheap measurement-gated option, not a known edge, and it depends on #6 to make its cross-name comparison valid.

by_pillar.title: Fix the meta-label isotonic calibration leak (purged cross-fit OOF calibration + sigmoid fallback for thin books; defer per-vol-bucket)
by_pillar.money_thesis: Standalone effect is second-order but REAL and on the binding-cost margin, and it is the highest-confidence money item because it is a verified defect, not a hypothesis. Mechanism: the leak biases p upward by ~+0.02-0.06 on the marginal band; correctly vetoing trades with TRUE p in [0.27,0.30) that the leak lifts over the 0.30 gate recovers ~1-3bps of avg per-trade net (a few % of annual P&L at realistic fill counts, concentrated on the WORST trades), and removing the ~0.03-in-p upward bias on the size multiplier stops over-betting losers (~+0.02-0.08 annualized Sharpe via better bet-size/edge alignment). Why it beat the rest of train_better: it is the ENABLING MULTIPLIER — picks #3/#4/#7 all consume p, and if p is not name-comparable they systematically tilt into high-VOL not high-EDGE names, a mis-allocation whose downside dwarfs this fix's standalone P&L. Cost-free, zero turnover, can only tighten the cost veto. Honest cap: do NOT credit it with flagship/Kelly dollars until those are live; value it standalone as bias-removal + correct cross-name sizing scale.
by_pillar.edge_thesis: Not a market anomaly — an internal estimation bias that persists until fixed and cannot be arbitraged. scikit-learn's own guide states the mistake verbatim: a calibrator fit on data the classifier's stopping already peeked at 'maps to probabilities closer to 0 and 1 than it should.' LightGBM objective:binary scores 'tend too much to the extremes' (Kull-Filho-Flach 2017), so the leak REINFORCES the booster's native over-extremity, double-biasing the p that gates cost. Economic mechanism: meta-p is the last gate before committing ~2x round-trip cost (META_VETO_PROB=0.30 sits right at the 2:1-RR breakeven p=0.333), so honest p shifts the operating point to reject more negative-expectancy fills.
by_pillar.literature: scikit-learn calibration guide (biased calibrator → 0/1; isotonic needs >~1000 samples else overfits, sigmoid for small n; CalibratedClassifierCV cross_val_predict for unbiased OOF). Niculescu-Mizil & Caruana 2005 (boosted trees need post-hoc calibration; Platt-vs-isotonic tradeoff). Kull-Filho-Flach 2017 'Beta calibration' (boosted scores tend to extremes; isotonic overfits small data). Hébert-Johnson et al. 2018 multicalibration (per-subgroup recalibration grounds per-vol-bucket). López de Prado AFML ch.3/ch.7 (meta-labeling needs an independent calibration set; purged k-fold + embargo).
by_pillar.implementation: mac_now (pure numpy/scipy — sklearn ABSENT on Mac, scipy.optimize.isotonic_regression PRESENT): (1) purged_kfold_indices(entry_ts, exit_ts, k, embargo_frac) using the exit_idx label spans from policy_exits.exit_walk — tests: folds partition rows as test exactly once, NO train row's [entry,exit] overlaps its fold span (synthetic overlap lattice), embargo buffer correct, tiny-n→single fold. (2) pure-numpy PAVA isotonic + a test asserting match to scipy.optimize.isotonic_regression to 1e-9. (3) pure Platt/sigmoid (Newton) for the <ISOTONIC_MIN_N fallback. (4) choose_calibration_method(n, min_n) + bucket-routing with fail-open to global. (5) LEAK-DETECTION regression test: a synthetic over-extreme booster score with known true win-rate — assert OLD same-slice calibration has lower Brier on its own slice but WORSE Brier/ECE on a fresh holdout than cross-fit. jetson_later: wire cross-fit into train_meta (K purged LGB fits, OOF concat, calibrate), reliability-curve + Brier/ECE before/after per book, decision_report veto-rate + net-per-trade A/B confirming fills/mo stays >= 30-floor (fix the floor with META_VETO_PROB, NEVER by re-adding bias), certify in shadow BEFORE any p-consuming sizing lever.
by_pillar.risk: Standalone dollars are small (a rounding error on a small fill count) — the value is enabler + integrity, so do NOT oversell it as alpha. Per-vol-bucket recalibration shrinks each sub-sample ~3x and the same small-n literature then bites the buckets hardest → DEFER per-vol; ship only the global purged-cross-fit + sigmoid-for-small-n core, and gate per-vol on a reliability-curve test showing global is materially off-diagonal AND each bucket clears a min-n. On the real ~200-2000-row meta set the OOF-vs-leaked Brier delta may be within noise — if so, ship the sigmoid-fallback-for-small-n piece only. Veto-rate could rise and threaten the liveness floor — instrument it in shadow first.

by_pillar.title: Tune the hardcoded 0.6/0.4 LSTM-LGB ensemble blend via OOF stacked weights (Stage-1 holdout-gate-honesty fix first; reweight as a bounded robustness overlay)
by_pillar.money_thesis: TWO welded parts; be honest which makes money. (A) The REAL prize is a SOUNDNESS/INTEGRITY fix worth more in avoided-regression than the reweight is in headline Sharpe: verified at hypersearch_v2.py:1084-1093 the holdout DSR_MIN=0.60 gate scores LSTM-ONLY preds, then train_lgb_ensemble runs AFTER (line ~1489), so the 0.6/0.4 blend that ACTUALLY TRADES (predict_now.py:372, backtest.py:115) is NEVER holdout-validated — every weekly promotion clears an honest-looking gate on a model that is not the one deployed, a silent overfit/regression hole on EVERY promotion. Fixing it (score the same model that trades) is the expected-P&L via drawdown-avoidance. (B) The reweight itself is genuinely second-order: GKX put the NN-vs-GBRT skill gap at ~0.03%/month and call combination gains 'modest'; realistic net +0.0-0.05 annualized Sharpe at ZERO added turnover, since w only re-weights an already-computed forecast (the ~6bps/~50bps hurdle is untouched). Why it beat other train_better candidates on reward-to-effort: a single scalar, low overfit (N=2/1-DOF = the forecast-combination puzzle at its structural minimum), touches EVERY decision (cost gate, threshold, meta pred, q10 veto, stock top-7 rank).
by_pillar.edge_thesis: Not a market edge — recovery of accuracy/robustness the guessed scalar leaves on the table. LSTM (sequence) and LGB (flattened-lag tabular) make structurally decorrelated errors, so the optimal convex blend has MSE <= the better leg (Breiman). The repo's own comment (hypersearch_v2.py:951, 'tree ensembles are the stronger learner at this data size, Grinsztajn 2022') is direct evidence the prior is mis-centered — 0.4 likely UNDER-weights LGB. Persists because it touches no market price; re-asserted every weekly retrain.
by_pillar.literature: Wolpert 1992 Stacked Generalization; Breiman 1996 Stacked Regressions (non-negativity CRUCIAL — unconstrained overfits OOS). Granger-Ramanathan 1984; Bates-Granger 1969. COUNTERWEIGHT — forecast-combination puzzle: Smith-Wallis 2009, Timmermann 2006, Genre/Timmermann 2012 'Can anything beat the simple average?' (estimated weights routinely lose to the simple average via finite-sample variance — but the variance GROWS with N, and here N=2). Diebold-Shin 2019 / Clemen-Winkler 1986 (shrink to equal weights). GKX 2020 (NN 1.35% vs GBRT 1.32% monthly OOS R^2; combining 'modest').
by_pillar.implementation: mac_now (scipy.optimize.nnls/minimize_scalar/spearmanr PRESENT): blend_fit.fit_blend_weight(lstm_oof, lgb_oof, y, objective='sharpe'|'nnls', threshold, shrink_to=0.5, shrink_lambda=0.5) — (A) Breiman NNLS→convex renormalize AND (B) 1-DOF bounded Sharpe-search on long-only policy Sharpe, then shrink to 0.5. Tests: recovers known optimum when one leg is stronger; NNLS and Sharpe-search agree within tol; convexity 0<=w<=1; perfect-correlation degenerate; shrinkage pulls toward 0.5; blended rank-IC >= max(leg IC); produces w!=0.6 only when data warrants. Generalize model_lgb.ensemble_predict to read w from config with 0.6 fallback (py_compile-checkable; lgb lines never run on Mac). jetson_later: STAGE 1 FIRST — reorder so LGB trains before evaluate_on_holdout and the gate scores the SAME blended preds; STAGE 2 — collect per-fold OOF (LSTM, LGB, returns), fit ONE global w per book, store in config dict (so champion/challenger isolate — predict_now.py:33 warns this exact globals bug); confirm ONCE on the untouched 12% holdout (DSR>=0.60); RETRAIN META after re-blend (the pred feature shifts).
by_pillar.risk: Reweight EV is ~0 (could land exactly zero after holdout-confirm); sell it as insurance, not alpha. Forecast-combination puzzle says aggressive weights overfit — shrink-to-0.5 + holdout-confirm cap the loss at ~0. Do NOT add w as an Optuna dim or regime-condition unless the global-per-book version first survives (each state multiplies the selection null for a sub-0.05-Sharpe prize the puzzle says is likely noise). MUST retrain meta after re-blend or the isotonic calibration + p<0.30 veto boundary silently drift on a shifted pred distribution.

by_pillar.title: Promote the diversified candidate pool (dv30 as-of top-K of universe ∪ pool) into the LIVE tradable stock universe — IC-by-name gated
by_pillar.money_thesis: The single largest STRUCTURAL pick_equities unlock: the model already scores 46 sector-diverse names (JPM/V/MA/LLY/UNH/GOOGL/MSFT/AMZN/XOM/JNJ...) — compute_live_panel_ranks ranks the full ~96-name panel (universe ∪ TRAINING_CANDIDATE_POOL) EVERY hour via panel_ranks.py:155 — but get_symbol_universe (stock_loop.py:90) returns only the 46 hand-list high-beta names, so the diversified scores are computed and DISCARDED. Enlarging the SELECTABLE set lets the top-7 buy the genuinely-highest-predicted names cross-sectionally. HONEST money: the headline +1-3pp/yr return is INFLATED (the √breadth math assumes constant IC, almost certainly FALSE on megacap defensives whose hourly returns are macro/rate-driven, not the ATR/RSI/ROC the model reads). The DURABLE, mechanical money is (a) DRAWDOWN DE-CLUSTERING — rotating ~30-50% of the book into staples/gold/healthcare on risk-off days the meme complex sells off together (pairwise corr 0.6-0.9) plausibly shaves 1.5-3pp off the worst-month drawdown, which compounds for a Kelly-sized book, and (b) a NET COST REDUCTION (rare for a breadth expansion) — pool megacaps have ~1-2bps EDGE spreads vs the meme tail's 5-15bps. Frame the win as tail-risk + cost, NOT standalone low-vol alpha (uncapturable at the EOD-flatten horizon).
by_pillar.edge_thesis: Two long-only-native edges. (1) BREADTH/DE-CORRELATION is portfolio MATH (Grinold IR≈IC·√Breadth on the LONG side that survives the long-only transfer coefficient), permanent by construction — the model already produces the raw signal; the constraint is purely an implementation choice in get_symbol_universe. (2) The mispricing captured is the bot's OWN structural blindness — its top-K selector is currently forbidden from rotating into defensives on the days the cross-section says to. Persistence risk honest: edge (1) is permanent; standalone low-vol/BAB alpha is small, post-2015 compressed, and NOT accessible at the intraday-flatten horizon.
by_pillar.literature: Grinold 1989 Fundamental Law; Clarke-de Silva-Thorley 2002 (long-only TC≈0.33, +108% with shorts — this adds breadth on the LONG half that survives). Frazzini-Pedersen 2014 BAB; Baker-Bradley-Wurgler 2011 (benchmark-relative-IR mandate = the persistence mechanism a paper bot doesn't share). Elton-Gruber-Blake 1996 survivorship (~200bps/yr from constituent selection). COUNTER-RISK: Avramov-Cheng-Metzker (ML profitability concentrated in illiquid/distressed/high-vol; ATTENUATED on liquid large-caps = this exact universe → IC gradient is weakest here, must be MEASURED not imported).

by_pillar.title: Activate the conviction-gated dynamic top-K + tier-A/B graduated sizing flagship (portfolio_backtest A/B evaluator now built) — Lever B prioritized over Lever A
by_pillar.money_thesis: Was the prior wave's #1; the two blockers (no A/B evaluator, no journals) are now resolved (portfolio_backtest.py confirmed to exist with top_k/conviction_gated/compare). Admission is a flat top-7 (stock_loop.py:52,510) and conviction is CLAMPED to [0.75,1.25] (base_loop.py:1305), so a rank-1 0.45% pred and rank-7 0.16% pred size within 1.7x despite a ~2.8x edge ratio. Two levers, but the refute critiques sharpen which makes money: LEVER A (when-to-be-flat) is LARGELY REDUNDANT — stock_loop.py already vetoes pred<threshold (:710), should_trade cost-floor (:721), and a 1.5x winner's-curse (:731), so the book ALREADY floats below 7 and partly to cash; Lever A's incremental delta is only the thin band [threshold, ratio_floor*threshold]. LEVER B (tier-A concentration of the top-3) is the differentiated money IF a rank gradient exists. Realistic combined: +0.10-0.20 portfolio Sharpe at unchanged-to-lower turnover, ~0 if the liquid universe shows no gradient — but experiment cost is ~zero because nothing ships live until Stage-0 confirms.
by_pillar.edge_thesis: Not new alpha — recovery of edge the clamp throws away. E[log(1+f·r)] is maximized when capital tracks each bet's edge/odds; the [0.75,1.25] clamp suppresses the growth-optimal allocation. The edge being concentrated is the system's OWN forecasting skill on a private universe — nothing to arbitrage; the only question is whether THIS model's rank-1-3 forecasts realize materially more net return than rank-6-7 on THIS liquid universe.
by_pillar.literature: GKX 2020 (NN decile-spread OOS Sharpe ~1.35-1.45; the long leg carries most ML alpha → implementable long-only). Cohen-Polk-Silli 2010 'Best Ideas' (highest-conviction overweight beats market & the manager's OTHER holdings by ~1.6-2.1%/quarter; non-best holdings show NO outperformance). arXiv 2402.15588 'Sizing the bets' (edge-PROPORTIONAL dominates equal-weight AND extreme concentration in geometric growth). by_pillar.title: Per-trade edge-and-probability fractional Kelly sizing (un-saturate the flat-topped meta multiplier; size proportional to calibrated edge) — gated on #1
by_pillar.money_thesis: Connect the one calibrated probability the system computes to the bet it never sizes with. compute_kelly_fraction collapses 200 trades into ONE pooled multiplier (base_loop.py:1269-1275); the conviction tier is computed (base_loop.py:1152) but only journaled; meta_size_mult=clip(2p,0.6,1.3) FLAT-TOPS at 1.3 for every p>=0.65 (so p=0.90 sizes identically to p=0.65); the pred-tilt saturates at 1.25x for any pred>=0.1875%. HONEST correction from the code read: the current map is NOT flat — over the realistic admitted-p band [0.46,0.68] today's top/bottom dispersion is ~1.41x while a naive AFML map is GENTLER (~1.22x). So the lever is NOT 'flat→proportional' (overstated); it is 'un-clip the 1.3 flat-top so genuine p>=0.75 conviction trades size up' + 'center on the per-book base-rate not 0.5'. Realistic net: +0-5% CAGR concentrated in high-dispersion months, Sharpe ~flat-to-up, turnover UNCHANGED (re-weights existing fills; 0.05 discretization can cut micro-trades). ~0 or negative if p stays miscalibrated.
by_pillar.edge_thesis: A self-inflicted geometric-growth leak in our own sizing, not a market anomaly — persists until fixed, no decay. Durable ONLY for operators with an honestly-calibrated p (why it isn't arbitraged: doing it WRONG blows up — Chopra-Ziemba: mean/p errors ~11x costlier than variance; a 5-pt p error swings Kelly ~3x; 'slight overbet ⇒ eventual ruin'). Since the top-10 are a cross-sectional ranking of a fixed 47-name universe, per-trade edge dispersion (rank-1 vs rank-7) is structurally material.
by_pillar.literature: Kelly 1956 (f*∝edge/odds). MacLean-Thorp-Ziemba 2011 (fractional Kelly cuts the ~50%-chance-of-50%-drawdown at small growth cost). Chopra-Ziemba 1993 (mean errors ~11x variance — getting p right dominates). López de Prado AFML ch.10 (bet-size from p: z=(p-1/n)/√(p(1-p)); 2Φ(z)-1; active-bet averaging for concurrency; step-0.05 discretization). Niculescu-Mizil & Caruana (overconfident trees inflate Kelly). Alpha Theory / Downey simulations (edge-proportional beats equal-weight; shrink for ruin-control not mean-noise).

Then Stage-0/decision_report must show rank_1_3 net >= 2x rank_6_7 in BOTH live journals AND holdout before any size-UP; backtest.py --gate must show higher compound growth with NON-WORSE max-drawdown.

The naive AFML map can size-DOWN the live 0.55-0.75 band — must be re-tuned (HI>1.3) so it does not haircut, AND it collides with TILT_MAX=1.30 (strategy_config.py:51) which clamps the whole tilt product, so the meta_mult must move outside that clamp or be raised explicitly or the lever is dead on arrival. by_pillar.title: Crypto cross-sectional momentum/relative-strength rank substrate — SOFT cost-neutral size tilt (drop the false 'cost-saving' exclusion core); restore 4 dropped coins first
by_pillar.money_thesis: On the cost-heaviest book (~50bps RT), selection is purely per-symbol (each coin independently clears trade_threshold, base_loop.py:1029) with no notion of which coin is strongest now; panel_ranks is stock-only. Wave-8 named this an honorable-mention gap, never built. CRITICAL refute correction that reshapes the candidate: the headline 'bottom-rank exclusion saves cost' is FALSE — order_utils should_trade already enforces abs(pred)>2x(fees+spread) BEFORE any crypto entry, so every laggard the exclusion would cut has ALREADY cleared the 2x cost floor and is model-positive-EV; excluding it OVERRIDES the model's signal with a coarse N=6 rank and is pure NEGATIVE EV unless the RS rank beats the model's own edge (the contested alpha claim, not a free lever). So ship ONLY the SOFT, bounded ([0.90,1.10]), cost-NEUTRAL size tilt that re-weights the SAME budget toward the RS leader — worst case a small misallocation, never a forgone positive-EV trade or extra round trip. Realistic: crypto-book Sharpe +0.05-0.15, portfolio-level small (crypto is a fraction of book).
by_pillar.edge_thesis: Under-reaction to coin-specific information among large liquid coins (lead-lag from BTC/ETH into alts, attention persistence). The offsetting short-term reversal that would make RS a trap is an ILLIQUIDITY effect confined to SMALL coins absent from this 6-10 set (Grobys-Sapkota: large caps show daily MOMENTUM not reversal). Crypto factor crowding far below equities; the effect is crash-prone (negative-skew premium that survives because it's painful to hold). Explicitly DISTINCT from the wave-7-KILLED carry rank (that mis-attributed a perp-funding Sharpe redundant with Funding_Z — momentum/RS is spot-tradable).
by_pillar.literature: Liu-Tsyvinski-Wu 2022 JF 'Common Risk Factors in Cryptocurrency' (market+SIZE+MOMENTUM 3-factor). Liu-Tsyvinski 2021 RFS (strong time-series momentum, 1-4wk). Grobys-Sapkota 2021 IRFA (large/liquid coins = momentum; reversal is the small-coin illiquidity trap — DECISIVE for this universe). Risk-managed CMOM (Sharpe 1.12→1.42 — raw signal crash-prone, benefits from vol/dispersion gating; Stivers-Sun dispersion-conditioning, already used by the stock CS_Dispersion). HONESTY: the cited 2.6%/wk CMOM is a QUINTILE long-short over 16,468 coins with NO cost analysis and a SIZE factor → most of it lives in small coins NOT held here.

by_pillar.title: BTC-native trend / TSMOM risk-off gate for the crypto book (graded de-risk via _extra_tilt; counterfactual-measured before live)
by_pillar.money_thesis: The cost-heaviest book (~50bps RT) has no NATIVE market-wide regime gate — crypto risk-off keys off EQUITY-vol proxies (VIX/STLFSI2) + a stablecoin-peg halt; macro_indicators get_spy_trend_ok (Faber 200d) is STOCKS-only. When BTC trends down the whole 6-coin book (corr 0.6-0.9) is the same losing long and ~50bps RT makes round-tripping pure bleed. A BTC 200h-SMA gap with hysteresis, wired as a GRADED de-risk scalar through CryptoLoop._extra_tilt (the funding-only hook), shrinks every crypto entry in risk-off. HONEST: the money mostly EVAPORATES into already-shipped machinery — get_book_vol_scalar (Moreira-Muir realized-vol-managed, portfolio.py:249), the stablecoin halt (macro_indicators:289 sizing_mult*=0.0), and the VIX/STLFSI2 gate ALREADY de-risk on most of these regimes, and the cited Quantpedia honesty-check says vol-scaling (already shipped) NOT the raw trend signal drives the headline. The uncovered residual is the crypto-IDIOSYNCRATIC, calm-VIX, no-depeg, multi-week BTC bleed (~0-1 events/yr). On a ~$25-40k paper sleeve at ~$1-3k/coin the avoided-drawdown is ~$1.5-2.5k/event + ~$300-700/yr recovered bleed — a Sharpe/survival hygiene item, not a P&L driver.
by_pillar.edge_thesis: Bitcoin has no cashflow anchor, so price is the dominant info aggregator and the market learns slowly (Detzel et al. rational-learning equilibrium) → multi-week trends. Trend-following is RISK-BEARING (pays for V-bottom reversals + whipsaw — the momentum-crash tax), so it cannot be costlessly arbitraged; crypto is young/retail/capacity-constrained so the predictability hasn't been competed flat. Horizon days-to-weeks (200h SMA) matches the hourly bars. Cost-POSITIVE by construction — only suppresses/shrinks entries, never adds a trade.
by_pillar.literature: Moskowitz-Ooi-Pedersen 2012 JFE TSMOM (~1.27%/mo vol-scaled, best in extreme markets — the crisis-hedge role). Detzel-Liu-Strauss-Zhou-Zhu 2021 FM (5-100d MAs predict BTC in+out-of-sample, rational-learning equilibrium — the KEY persistence mechanism; macro vars do NOT predict BTC). Liu-Tsyvinski 2021 RFS (strong crypto TSMOM). Faber 2007/2013 (200d SMA cut maxDD 83.7%→42.2%, already cited macro_indicators.py:200). HONESTY: Quantpedia bootstrap-TSMOM (bare TSMOM OOS-Sharpe ~0.1-0.2, often NEGATIVE OOS; vol-scaling drives the headline) → sell as DRAWDOWN insurance, validate OOS, never P&L-tune. IMF 2022/CME 2025 (crypto-equity corr→~1:1 in macro risk-off → the existing VIX gate already catches macro crashes; value is idiosyncratic-only).

by_pillar.risk: Largely redundant with shipped vol-scaling + stablecoin halt + VIX gate — the unique edge is a thin, rare residual, so this is marginal money (rank it LAST). Double-counting is a real soundness hole (4 de-risk terms multiply into one tilt). Whipsaw is the literature's own verdict (bare TSMOM often OOS-negative) — hysteresis + tanh + 3-bar persistence are the edge, not optional. On a small paper book the avoided-loss improves the Sharpe denominator but adds little compounded P&L. The bar to flip on is the counterfactual showing INCREMENTAL (not co-fired) de-risk events.

result.portfolio_note: This set is deliberately built as a DEPENDENCY CHAIN, not a basket of independent bets, because the cost + long-only reality means the durable money is in BETTER SELECTION/SIZING of longs and INTEGRITY of the promotion gate — not new high-turnover alpha (cost-bled on the ~50bps crypto book) and not shorts/funding/basis (KILLED waves 5-7, infeasible here). SEQUENCING IS THE PLAN: ship the two train_better SOUNDNESS items FIRST — the calibration-leak fix (#1) and the blend-gate-honesty fix (#2-Stage-1) — because they are the only VERIFIED defects, carry bounded downside, add ZERO turnover, and are the enabling multipliers: every downstream sizing/selection lever (#3 universe IC-comparison, #4 conviction tiers, #5 Kelly, #6 crypto RS) sizes or selects the WRONG names if p is miscalibrated and promotes the wrong model if the gate scores LSTM-only. The honest expected-money picture, folding in every refute critique: the BIG durable wins are (a) avoided promotion-regressions (#2 Stage-1) and avoided negative-expectancy fills + correct cross-name sizing (#1), (b) DRAWDOWN DE-CLUSTERING + a NET COST REDUCTION from a more diversified long set (#3) — which compounds for a Kelly-sized book far more than the headline return-alpha that the critiques correctly deflate to near-zero on this liquid universe. Everything model-facing ships DEFAULT-OFF behind a flag and is gated on a MEASUREMENT that kills it cheaply if the edge is absent: IC-by-name for #3, the rank-gradient Stage-0 (rank_1_3 net >= ~2x rank_6_7 in BOTH live-journal AND holdout) for #4/#5, the laggard-underperformance Stage-0 for #6, the co-fire counterfactual for #7. The mac_now deliverables are uniformly measurement-safe (pure-numpy kernels, panel_from_frame + compare_deflated which ALSO closes a real multiple-testing leak in portfolio_backtest.compare, IC diagnostics, default-off config) so the whole wave is committable now with zero live-path impact; the jetson_later half is pure validation. Two cost realities keep the set honest: tier-A concentration (#4/#5) is INERT until the $5k notional cap binds and the raise clears the sqrt-impact model, and the crypto items (#6/#7) are small portfolio-level dollars on a fractional, ~50bps book — so they rank last and are framed as Sharpe/survival/cost hygiene, not P&L drivers. This ordering maximizes realized money per unit of risk and per unit of Jetson compute: fix the gate, fix the probability, then let breadth and edge-proportional sizing express through a now-trustworthy stack.
